function: Massive MIMO symbol detection: purely data-driven permutation-equivariant ChannelNet network recovering transmitted QAM symbols from received signal and channel matrix (pp. 4-6).
system: Uplink massive MIMO: Nt single-antenna users, Nr BS antennas, (64,32) and (128,64); 16/64-QAM; frequency-flat narrowband; no RIS; 3GPP case at 3.5 GHz (pp. 2, 8).
method: ChannelNet: iterative MLP/convolutional antenna-feature processors with channel-matrix linear layers, 20 iterations, d=10; supervised cross-entropy training with Adam, 600 epochs; no fine-tuning (pp. 4-7).
data_channel: Simulated: Rayleigh i.i.d. CN(0,1/Nr), Kronecker exponential correlation 0.6, and 3GPP 3D-UMa/UMi-NLOS channels from QuaDRiGa at 3.5 GHz; 2e6 samples per epoch (pp. 7-8).
test_conditions: Same channel type for train/test; shift tests: train 3D-UMa-NLOS, test 3D-UMi-NLOS; train clean, test with CSI error (15/20 dB) or t/Laplace noise (pp. 8-10).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE, AMP, V-BLAST, ML (Gurobi); learned: DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN, RE-MIMO, with official code of each (pp. 7-8).
metrics: Symbol error rate versus SNR; number of multiplications; inference and training time per batch of 256 on an NVIDIA 4090 GPU (pp. 7, 11-12).
complexity: Order O(NtNr); exact multiplications L(dNK+2d²K+2d²N); Table I: 0.98e7 multiplications, 0.88 ms inference at Nt=32, Nr=64 (pp. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 8: "simulated using the QuaDRiGa channel simulator" for the 3GPP 3D-UMa-NLOS channels, on which models are trained and tested (Fig. 5). p. 18: reference [51] is "Study on 3-D channel model for LTE" (TR 36.873).
q2_support: p. 9: "to simulate a channel distribution shift", training on 3D-UMa-NLOS and testing on 3D-UMi-NLOS; p. 10: Fig. 5 caption tests on "out-of-distribution channels".
q3_support: p. 7: MMSE, AMP, V-BLAST and ML as non-learned baselines ("A classical linear detector") and DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN, RE-MIMO as learned ones ("A learning-based detector that unfolds OAMP"); p. 8: "ChannelNet-MLP consistently matches or outperforms other detectors" on SER.
q4_support: p. 11: "the overall number of multiplications for ChannelNet-MLP is" L(dNK+2d²K+2d²N), asymptotically O(NtNr); p. 12: "TABLE I: Computational complexity comparison of massive MIMO detectors." with multiplications and inference/train times.
q5_support: p. 7: "We use the official repository at" appears only for the baselines DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN and RE-MIMO; no code or data link is given for ChannelNet, and the channels are simulated (p. 8).
notes: Reference [51] of the 3GPP case is TR 36.873 (3-D channel model for LTE, p. 18), simulated with QuaDRiGa; the instructions list QuaDRiGa for q1, so marked met, reviewer to confirm. q5 = 0 because only the baselines' repositories are cited; QuaDRiGa is a public simulator but the paper generates its own samples, so it is not counted as a public dataset. The CSI-error and non-Gaussian-noise tests (p. 9-10) are sweeps and are not what q2 rests on. Table I values were read from the page image of p. 12.
